# After the Host of Eindil exists (the .92 options, or the journey stage 9 runner): invitations to ride with the heir (humans), the coalition and the Lost Cause. Once only. Scope: any.
zin_eindil_after_host_raised = {
	if = {

		every_country = {
			limit = {

			}
			country_event = {
				id = zin_eindil.93
				days = 1
			}
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					check_variable = { zin_eindil_regard > 24.999 }
					has_country_flag = zin_west_stranded
					has_country_flag = zin_east_companies_with_eindil
				}
				NOT = { zin_eindil_is_host = yes }
				NOT = { zin_is_volgan = yes }
				NOT = { zin_is_zol = yes }
				NOT = { zin_afrit_is_hub = yes }
				NOT = { zin_afrit_rules_here = yes }
			}
			country_event = {
				id = zin_eindil.94
				days = 7
			}
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				zin_lost_cause_exists = yes
				is_faction_leader = yes
				NOT = { zin_eindil_is_host = yes }
			}

				days = 7
